Strategy: Reward bins whose post-placement residual lands between ten and twenty-five, a small leftover that many future items can still use. This prefers keeping modest usable gaps over filling bins completely, but the band may be too narrow to matter and tight fits may lose out.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 10 and r - item <= 25 else 0) for r in bins]
```
